test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. My husband would not be back until late and I decided to settle down in a comfortable chair and read a book.

B. I put the children to bed early and prepared some coffee.

C. It had been a tiring day and I was looking forward to a quiet evening.

D. Soon I was sitting comfortably with a cup of coffee and the book.
solution:
The correct answer is 'CABD'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some __grammatical or contextual __connections between them. Also, the first sentence of a passage is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 

__
 
• Sentence C is the independent sentence and introduces what the subject was thinking of doing. It states how the subject had a tiring day and was looking forward to a quiet evening. 
 
• So, sentence C is the first sentence after rearrangement. 
 
• Sentence A describes how the subject knew that her husband would come late and how she decided that she would relax by reading a book. Thus, to maintain continuity, sentence A comes in the second position. Hence, A follows C.__
 
• Sentence B which explains the actions taken by the subject after she decided what to do should come after sentence A, to maintain continuity on the topic. 
 
• Sentence D is the concluding statement of the passage as it provides further information regarding how the subject finally was sitting and reading her book. 

Thus, the correct order after rearrangement is option 3 i.e. CABD.

*So, the correct paragraph is : (**C) It had been a tiring day and I was looking forward to a quiet evening. (A) My husband would not be back until late and I decided to settle down in a comfortable chair and read a book. (B) I put the children to bed early and prepared some coffee. (D) Soon I was sitting comfortably with a cup of coffee and the book.***
